name: assembly-newsh2-9
summary: A long segmented pipe lying across the screen on low supports (8 ground pieces, 192x28 px): a light grey bullet nose on the left, six identical segments of grey rings, narrow red collars and a big red flange with a red bracket stand, and an end piece with a bigger flange and a grey cylinder with a rounded cap. Round, constant-diameter pipe sections with crisp chamfered ring edges; the dark band under the pipe is its supports and rail, with ground showing through under the collars.

traits: three grey ring sections per segment (cols 100-103, 108-112, 117-119), about 8 px across (rows 7-14)
round: about as tall as they are wide, lit along the upper middle
crisp chamfered ends with a dark seam between neighbouring rings, not rounded beads
features.note: The pipe body of each newsh2-9 segment (here the exported one, cols 96-119).

traits: two narrow red bands per segment (cols 97-99 and 105-107), 5 px across (rows 9-13)
thinner than the grey rings, so they read as a waist between rings
ground visible beneath them (the sprite is transparent at row 14 below them)
features.note: Red collars / couplings between the grey rings.

traits: red disc 4 px wide (cols 113-116), wider than the pipe (rows 6-14)
lit left rim (pale pink column 113)
flat faces with a crisp edge
red bracket under the flange (cols 113-116, rows 15-18)
a frame with a see-through hole at row 16: dark red left post, dark top bar, lit foot bar at row 18
stands on the ground and reaches up to the flange
dark grey cradle blocks under each grey ring (rows 15-18), sloping from the pipe to the ground
a thin dark rail along row 15-16 joining them
gaps showing ground under the red collars
features.note: What the sprite draws as the dark band under the pipe: the pipe stands on these, a few px off the ground.

traits: light grey bullet / ogive, tapering from the pipe's full width to a point at col 2
round in section, its tip drooping to the ground
shiny metal: the bright streak is sheen
bigger red flange (cols 170-173, rows 5-14) with a lit left rim
its own bracket stand below (rows 15-19) with a hole at row 17
features.note: Flange of the right end piece newsh2-11.

traits: grey cylinder of the pipe's diameter (cols 182-191)
rounded cap at the right end
features.note: The closed right end of the pipe.
